description: JavaScript source code for a selection sharing widget that enables sharing selected text via Twitter, Facebook, and email, with popunder UI elements and integration with social media meta tags.

classes.name: b
classes.description: Main class handling selection sharing, popunder UI, and social media interactions.

methods.name: getSelectionText
methods.description: Retrieves the text and HTML content of the current selection.

methods.name: selectionDirection
methods.description: Determines the direction of the current text selection.

methods.name: showPopunder
methods.description: Displays the popunder UI near the selected text.

methods.name: pushSiblings
methods.description: Adds classes to sibling elements for UI effects.

methods.name: show
methods.description: Shows the sharing popover for the current selection.

methods.name: smart_truncate
methods.description: Truncates text to a specified length with ellipsis.

methods.name: getRelatedTwitterAccounts
methods.description: Retrieves related Twitter accounts for sharing.

methods.name: shareTwitter
methods.description: Shares the selected text on Twitter.

methods.name: shareFacebook
methods.description: Shares the selected text on Facebook.

methods.name: shareEmail
methods.description: Shares the selected text via email.

methods.name: setElements
methods.description: Sets the DOM elements to attach event handlers for selection sharing.
